item.tib: srid rgyal thugs kyi sgrub thabs nag mo'i mthu sgrub kyi gzhung
item.coloph: de ltar rgyal mo thugs kyi sgrub (sgrub) pa nag mo'i mthu bsgrub (sgrub) tu bstan pa 'di ni gsang ba 'dus pa'i thugs kyi brnag pa/ stag la me 'bar gyi bsgrub (sgrub) pa/ mi lus bsam legs kyis mdzad byang / shes mkha' 'gro srid rgyal sngon mo nor bu'i thor gtsug can des nges med rnal 'byor bdag la phag lo'i ston zla tha chung gi nyer gcig gi nyin la smin grol nor bu'i rtser 'dzin ri khrod du snyan du brgyad pa'o/ sa ma ya/ yang tig zab bo// rgya rgya rgya//
